integrity: Self-contained analytical argument with runnable exact-rational finite checks; no independent audit or publication certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to undirected two-hop cycles of order at least five under uniform within-class linear edge prices; the mixed optimum is implicit. Generic convex resistance minimization, fixed-unit cycle formulas and parity connectivity are known antecedents. An equivalent result in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Price-induced parity bifurcation for minimum-resistance two-hop rings
